title: Teacher compares four variant previews and chooses one before review
turnSequence: Teacher submits a valid 4.NF.A.1 objective in the studio and waits for ready-for-review.
The studio renders four variant cards (src/components/studio/teacher-studio.tsx:551) with distinct hooks.
Teacher previews the chosen variant, checks the explanation against the objective, and selects it (input[name="chosen-variant"]).
Teacher opens the review surface for the chosen draft.
expected: Four ready variants render as individually selectable cards with per-variant titles; the teacher's choice is recorded and the review surface opens for that request. Whether the four hooks are genuinely different is a model-output-quality judgment recorded from the observed trace, not assumed.
observableFailure: Fewer than four variants render, cards are not selectable, the choice is not persisted, or all four variants are structurally identical copies.
flipCondition: Requires a reachable lesson provider (live model) and a running server with a browser; unblocks when EVAL_LIVE_MODEL=1 is set and S0's generation step succeeds.
